provenance: Reviewed development environment for original SymPy 1.0-1.6 sources: legacy evaluate=False constructs ast.Name(False), rejected by CPython 3.9. Use source-built CPython 3.6.15 with pinned OpenSSL, within setup.py supported Python ranges; retain mpmath 1.3.0 (declared >=0.19) and Python-3.6-compatible tooling. This differs from the current SWE harness default Python 3.9; original problem/source/test patches and scoring stay unchanged. No target SymPy package or source fix is baked into the image.
